description: clientDataJSON carries a different challenge than the server issued; must be rejected.
name: auth-challenge-mismatch

description: Assertion signed by a DIFFERENT ES256 key than the registered credential public key (credential substitution); signature verification must fail.
name: auth-credential-substitution

description: Assertion clientDataJSON has crossOrigin:true plus topOrigin naming the embedding page; the verifier must reject this APP-SIDE — py_webauthn 2.8 accepts it (topOrigin is not even parsed).
name: auth-crossorigin-true-toporigin

description: Assertion clientDataJSON has crossOrigin:true (ceremony ran inside a cross-origin iframe); the verifier must reject this APP-SIDE — py_webauthn 2.8 accepts it (crossOrigin is parsed but never checked).
name: auth-crossorigin-true

description: Valid ED25519 assertion, UP+UV set, sign count 0 -> 1.
name: auth-ed25519-uv

description: Valid ES256 assertion with BE=1 and BS=1 (synced passkey).
name: auth-es256-backup-eligible-backed-up

description: Valid ES256 assertion without user verification (UV=0); server verifies with require_user_verification=False.
name: auth-es256-nouv

description: Valid ES256 assertion where the counter advances 41 -> 42.
name: auth-es256-signcount-increment

description: Valid ES256 assertion from a counter-less authenticator: stored count 0 and response count 0 must be accepted.
name: auth-es256-signcount-zero

description: Valid ES256 assertion, UP+UV set, sign count 0 -> 1.
name: auth-es256-uv

description: clientDataJSON origin differs from the expected origin; must be rejected.
name: auth-origin-mismatch

description: authData rpIdHash computed over a different RP ID; must be rejected.
name: auth-rpidhash-mismatch

description: Valid RS256 assertion, UP+UV set, sign count 0 -> 1.
name: auth-rs256-uv

description: Replayed counter: response count equals the stored count (42); must be rejected.
name: auth-signcount-equal

description: Sign count regression: response count 41 while the server has already seen 42 (possible cloned authenticator); must be rejected.
name: auth-signcount-regression

description: clientDataJSON type is webauthn.create inside an authentication ceremony; must be rejected.
name: auth-type-mismatch

description: UP flag is 0 (no user presence) in an assertion; must be rejected.
name: auth-up-missing

description: UV flag is 0 but the server requires user verification; must be rejected.
name: auth-uv-required-missing

description: BS=1 with BE=0 is an impossible backup state per the WebAuthn spec; must be rejected.
name: reg-bs-without-be

description: clientDataJSON carries a different challenge than the server issued; must be rejected.
name: reg-challenge-mismatch

description: clientDataJSON has crossOrigin:true plus topOrigin naming the embedding page; the verifier must reject this APP-SIDE — py_webauthn 2.8 accepts it (topOrigin is not even parsed).
name: reg-crossorigin-true-toporigin

description: clientDataJSON has crossOrigin:true (ceremony ran inside a cross-origin iframe); the verifier must reject this APP-SIDE — py_webauthn 2.8 accepts it (crossOrigin is parsed but never checked).
name: reg-crossorigin-true

description: Valid ED25519 registration, UP+UV set, attestation none.
name: reg-ed25519-uv

description: Valid ES256 registration with BE=1 and BS=1 (synced/multi-device passkey, currently backed up).
name: reg-es256-backup-eligible-backed-up

description: Valid ES256 registration with BE=1 and BS=0 (multi-device eligible, not currently backed up).
name: reg-es256-backup-eligible-not-backed-up

description: Valid ES256 registration where the client requested the credProps extension and the client reported rk:true in clientExtensionResults. py_webauthn 2.8 drops clientExtensionResults when parsing and returns no extension output, so the verifier must read credProps.rk from the credential JSON itself and mark the credential discoverable.
name: reg-es256-credprops

description: Valid ES256 registration with an initial sign count of 42; the server must store 42 as the credential's starting counter.
name: reg-es256-nonzero-signcount

description: Valid ES256 registration without user verification (UV=0); server verifies with require_user_verification=False.
name: reg-es256-nouv

description: Valid ES256 registration, UP+UV set, attestation none.
name: reg-es256-uv

description: clientDataJSON origin is a different origin than the server expects; must be rejected.
name: reg-origin-mismatch

description: authData rpIdHash computed over a different RP ID than the server expects; must be rejected.
name: reg-rpidhash-mismatch

description: Valid RS256 registration, UP+UV set, attestation none.
name: reg-rs256-uv

description: clientDataJSON type is webauthn.get inside a registration ceremony; must be rejected.
name: reg-type-mismatch

description: UP flag is 0 (no user presence) with user presence required; must be rejected.
name: reg-up-missing

description: UV flag is 0 but the server requires user verification; must be rejected.
name: reg-uv-required-missing
